title: Demo Paper: A Light-Touch Approach to Curriculum Distillation
abstract: We propose a light-touch curriculum distillation framework that achieves competitive accuracy on three benchmarks while halving the teacher's compute.

sections.heading: Introduction
paragraphs: Knowledge distillation typically requires running an expensive teacher over the entire training set; we study whether selective distillation can match this quality with substantially less teacher compute.

sections.heading: Method
paragraphs: We propose a difficulty-aware sampler that requests teacher labels only for examples where the student's predictive entropy exceeds a threshold.

sections.heading: Experiments
paragraphs: On CIFAR-100, ImageNet-1k, and a 3M-example text classification benchmark, our method matches dense distillation within 0.4 accuracy points while reducing teacher compute by 51%.
